description: inventory-service event consumption, stale-hold expiry, contract test, docs. Consumes order-events in group 'inventory' with its own inbox, retry topics and DLT (same pattern as order-platform), own event classes, unknown types skipped: order.confirmed -> CONFIRMED, order.shipped -> SHIPPED. ShedLock job releases HELD reservations older than hold-ttl (45m > order-platform's 30m cancel-after); CONFIRMED never expires. Depends on FEAT-003 (StockService transitions, base test class, scheduling config) and on the event shapes from FEAT-002.
steps: Flyway V4__create_processed_events.sql and V5__create_dead_letters.sql (copy order-platform V4 and V6).

events/: EventEnvelope, Payload (sealed: OrderConfirmed(orderId, @Nullable reservationId), OrderShipped(orderId, reservationId), UnknownPayload), PayloadTypeIdResolver, UnknownPayload, OrderEvents (topic constant + NewTopic 3 partitions), KafkaTemplates (retryKafkaTemplate, observed), ProcessedEvents, ProcessedEventsPurge, DeadLetters, OrderEventHandler, OrderEventListener (@RetryableTopic, @KafkaListener groupId inventory, @DltHandler). Add the kafka consumer block (bootstrap localhost:9092, ErrorHandlingDeserializer, default type com.shopflow.inventory.events.EventEnvelope, use.type.headers false, trusted packages) and listener.observation-enabled to application.yaml. Handler: skip UnknownPayload and a null/blank reservationId with a log (no inbox row, no throw), mark processed, call StockService.confirm/ship; unknown reservation is logged and skipped; transitions only move forward.

domain/HeldReservationExpiry: @Scheduled(cron = ${shopflow.inventory.expiry-cron:0 */5 * * * *}) + @SchedulerLock(name = expireHeldReservations); find HELD ids with created_at before now - hold-ttl and release each in its own transaction through the same release path. Add the hold-ttl/expiry-cron/processed-events-retention properties (a @ConfigurationProperties record with @DefaultValue like order-platform).

Switch the shared test base to a real Kafka listener (remove auto-startup=false) once the listener exists; keep one context for all integration tests. Tests: OrderEventConsumerTest (confirmed, shipped, same event id twice, unknown type, unknown reservation, shipped-before-confirmed stays SHIPPED, poison message reaches the DLT/dead_letters); HeldReservationExpiryTest (back-date created_at via jdbc and call the job; old HELD released and stock restored, young HELD kept, old CONFIRMED kept); contract tests: abstract StockContract with the calls both targets can answer (valid reserve, release of it, GET stock; status + JSON field names/types), WireMockStubContractTest against a WireMock container loaded with deploy/wiremock/inventory, RealServiceContractTest extends the shared base using a service-account token. Error paths are asserted only against the real service; say so in Javadoc.

Docs: rewrite inventory-service/README.md; update deploy/wiremock/README.md (service is real, stand-in is for failure drills, ignores the token, port 8081 clash, compose location); docs/NOTES.md (stale placeholder/stand-in wording around lines 247 and 261, compose/realm paragraph around 452, new section for the decisions: token handling in tests, event contract changes, release after ship = 409, expiry TTL vs cancel-after, compose profiles and start-only); order-platform/http/shopflow-api.http or README if they mention starting inventory; docs/user-stories.md only if a story text became wrong.

CI: refresh the stale comments in .github/workflows/ci.yml (module list, Error Prone scope, Keycloak context count). Run the root build, record wall time; if it approaches 8 minutes, reduce container/context count (reuse containers) before touching the thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Delivering the same order.confirmed or order.shipped event twice leaves the reservation in the same state and one processed_events row
An event of an unknown type or for an unknown reservation does not throw and does not reach the DLT
A HELD reservation older than hold-ttl is released and its stock returned; CONFIRMED and SHIPPED are never touched; two instances never run the job at once (ShedLock)
The contract tests pass against both the WireMock stubs and the real service with the same requests
./mvnw -B -ntp verify at the repo root passes; CI-equivalent wall time is recorded in findings and stays under the 10 minute target
READMEs and docs/NOTES.md match the new reality
verification: ./mvnw -B -ntp verify  (root, all modules; script + log files; note total duration)
findings: Done. ./mvnw -B -ntp -pl inventory-service verify: 57 tests (+16: OrderEventConsumerTest 6, HeldReservationExpiryTest 4, RealServiceContractTest 3, WireMockStubContractTest 3), 0 failures, 0 skips, BUILD SUCCESS 1m07s (log inventory-service/target/feat004.log). Root ./mvnw -B -ntp verify: BUILD SUCCESS, total 3m09s wall locally (order-platform 2:02, inventory-service 1:01, starter 4s; log target/feat004-root.log), well under the 10 min CI target and the 6 min warn threshold, so no container/context reduction and thresholds untouched. Inventory still has one Keycloak context (~33 s in SecurityIntegrationTest); OrderEventConsumerTest 10.6 s. Decisions/deviations: (1) Properties record is com.shopflow.inventory.InventoryProperties (prefix shopflow.inventory: holdTtl 45m, processedEventsRetention 14d) plus @ConfigurationPropertiesScan on the app class; expiry-cron is read with a ${...:default} placeholder in @Scheduled, not bound. (2) Expiry job calls new StockService.releaseIfStillHeld(id, cutoff) (row lock, re-checks HELD and created_at < cutoff, shares private giveBack with release) so a confirmation between select and release wins; ReservationRepository.findHeldIdsCreatedBefore added. (3) Own event classes: OrderConfirmed(orderId, @Nullable reservationId) ignoring other fields; OrderShipped(orderId, @Nullable reservationId); EventEnvelope.of removed. Handler: UnknownPayload and null/blank reservationId are skipped before the inbox mark; unknown reservation is marked processed and logged (no change). Consumer name = group = 'inventory'. (4) Poison test: reservationId containing a NUL char makes PostgreSQL reject the update, so the event is retried 4x and stored in dead_letters (~4-5 s); unparseable bytes only go to the DLT topic, not asserted. (5) Contract: StockContract is an interface with default @Test methods (so RealServiceContractTest can extend InventoryIntegrationTest); uses java.net.http, no WireMock Java dependency; WireMockStubContractTest has no Spring context. Test package contract has no package-info (not NullMarked, so NullAway ignores it). (6) Test base now has no properties (kafka listener auto-start on); still a single shared context. (7) Docs: inventory-service/README.md rewritten, deploy/wiremock/README.md (real service, drills only, ignores token, 8081 clash), docs/NOTES.md (placeholder bullet replaced, shopflow-service roles row, new section 'inventory-service: how it works with order-platform'; lines ~247/261 were virtual-thread text and are not stale, left alone), docs/user-stories.md placeholder note fixed, ci.yml header and Keycloak comment refreshed. order-platform/http has no inventory mention, untouched. check-skipped-tests.sh not run locally (all reports show 0 skipped).
